title: The Deepest Spot on Earth Has 8 Tons Pressing on Every Inch

scenes.text: At the deepest spot in the ocean, eight tons press on every square inch.
It is the Challenger Deep, nearly 11 kilometres down.
The pressure is over 1,000 times what you feel at sea level.
As of 2022, only 27 people had ever been there.
The first two, in 1960, stayed barely 20 minutes.
Twenty minutes, at eight tons on every inch.

description:
The Challenger Deep is nearly 11 kilometres down, where the pressure is over 1,000 times sea level, about 8 tons per square inch.
By 2022 only 27 people had ever gone there.
Would you go down?
first_comment: Would you go to the deepest point in the ocean? Be honest.
